answer: Every agent identity is minted from a hardware-attested kernel measurement, so a thousand sock puppets still resolve to one physical machine. Duplicate fingerprints collapse into a single bonded claim held in a shared reef of escrowed collateral, and reputation accrues only through settled trades. Attestation depth tints each cluster on the ledger, raw umber for unproven newcomers, deep ochre for lineages that survived repeated audit.
